tips.text: The festival is held at VAZ Schladnitz in Leoben. Trains from Vienna take ~2.5 hours.
Local shuttle buses run from Leoben Hauptbahnhof to the festival grounds every 30 minutes.
The on-site Medical Center is located next to the main entrance.
Area 53 uses a cashless system. You can top up your wristband at any of the 4 stations.
Debit and Credit cards are accepted for the initial top-up.
